investigation.mechanism: In free drive with the reviewed lumen loaded, driveScope advances the tip along its own optical axis against the collider and locateTip names the airway from the nearest centerline among edges sharing a node with the current one. There is no branch-selection rule, no default side and no authored fork behaviour. The aim guard is set only for mode === 'guided-walk' (scopeMotion.ts), and the guided-walk step at the same fork behaves as authored: a neutral advance does not choose a branch and an undecided aim prints the aim-guard refusal.

geometryMeasurement.method: angle between the distal tracheal centerline direction (last 10 mm) and each main bronchus direction over its first 10 mm beyond the carina node
geometryMeasurement.conclusion: The authored centerlines are near-symmetric at the carina. This model has no markedly straighter right main for a neutral push to follow, so the report's expectation is not a property of the geometry in use.

findings.disposition: investigated; no defect found; no change made; owner decision recorded

residualHumanDecision.question: What should a neutral advance do at a fork in free drive?

options.consequence: No code change. The learner steers either way with the same controls. Nothing on the free-drive views says how the fork is resolved.

options.option: disclose it in the view boundary
options.consequence: One sentence in the two view-loss boundaries, mirroring the guided-walk boundary that already names its three assists. No behaviour change. Authored learner copy, owned by lane 02.

options.option: extend the aim guard to free drive
options.consequence: A real behaviour change. An undecided advance would be refused at every fork, changing the view-loss, right-side, left-side, systematic-survey and scope-in-a-tube tasks, and free drive would no longer be recorded as unaided.

residualHumanDecision.notAnOption: Making the neutral input favour the right would mean replacing reviewed source geometry, which this batch is not authorised to do and did not do.
